traits.name: Deadly Speed
traits.description: At the start of each scene, if the nimbleform singer isn't Surprised, they can take a fast turn before any other characters (this doesn't count as their turn this round).

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: The nimbleform singer can spend 1 focus to gain an advantage on a Perception test (no action required).

actions.name: Chosen Target
actions.description: Costs 2 Focus. The nimbleform singer chooses an enemy they can sense within 120 feet of them. For 1 hour, when the nimbleform hits their chosen enemy with a weapon attack, they deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage. In addition, the nimbleform singer gains an advantage on Survival tests to track that enemy.

strikes.name: Mace
strikes.description: Attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) impact damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) impact damage.

strikes.name: Shortbow
strikes.description: Attack +5, range 80/320 ft., one target. Graze: 3 (1d6) keen damage. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) keen damage.
